subject: Re: Request for temporary quota uplift and billing terms for May campaign
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: BrightCart Finance <finance@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Unexpected traffic spike and quota request

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — we kicked off a paid acquisition blast this morning and are seeing ~3.8x our usual token volume in generation calls. The spike started around 06:30 PT and is still building. Our engineers flagged sustained higher qps for the last 2 hours.

Can Redwood temporarily increase our quota or enable a short-term burst window? We need at least a 3x uplift for the next 72 hours, or until we can throttle client-side. We want to avoid throttling customers mid-checkout.

Two asks: 1) can you turn up our throughput immediately (even with an overrun billing hold) and 2) can you propose a simple billing approach — we prefer a capped buffer or a predictable overrun rate rather than surprise invoices.

Attached: usage_report_May.csv (snapshot) showing the spike.

Appreciate a fast response — happy to hop on a <30m call.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform
BrightCart
[Attachment: usage_report_May.csv (4KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Unexpected traffic spike and quota request

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the report.

We can absolutely help short-term. Immediate options:
- Provision a temporary 3x quota uplift for up to 72 hours (manual override)
- Enable an "escrow buffer" (see proposed terms) to cap your exposure — usage in the buffer is billed at a reduced overrun rate and reconciled after the event

Before I flip the switch I need: a) an estimate of expected peak qps/tokens during the window, b) whether you want a hard cap (stop at X) vs soft cap (throttle after buffer), and c) confirmation that you accept our temporary overrun terms (we can send a brief SOW amendment).

I’m looping in Vivek for pricing/discounts and Marissa for billing mechanics. We can do a 20–30m call now if that helps.

Proposed immediate attachment: proposed_microburst_terms.pdf (draft).

— Soojin
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_microburst_terms.pdf (1 page)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: Unexpected traffic spike and quota request

Quick thoughts — we should offer a short-term, predictable pricing path rather than full retail overrun billing; keeps customer happy and reduces escalation risk. Proposal options:

Option A (buffer + reduced rate):
- Add a burst escrow buffer of 120M tokens for the 72h window
- Tokens within buffer billed at 60% of standard overrun rate (list overrun = $0.00030/token => buffer rate = $0.00018/token)
- Any consumption beyond buffer billed at standard overrun rate
- One-time good-faith credit of $12,500 applied to next invoice if total overrun stays within buffer + 20% margin next monthly cycle

Option B (flat uplift + blended discount):
- Temporary 3x quota for 72h applied to existing commitment
- Blended overrun discount of 15% across uplifted usage
- No post-event credit; reconciliation on next invoice

Operational notes: need Marissa to confirm whether finance can accept a credit path versus a direct discount; legal will want a very short SOW amendment and DocuSign link.

If customer wants more certainty we can also present a hybrid: buffer + smaller credit. Thoughts?

— Vivek
Senior AE

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: Unexpected traffic spike and quota request

I can approve a one-time credit or a reduced buffer rate. Finance preference is: keep the pricing simple on the invoice and apply credits rather than carve complex retroactive discounts (easier for our accounting). My recommendation:

- Approve Option A but adjust credit to $12,500 (good-faith credit)
- Buffer rate = 60% of list overrun rate (as Vivek suggested)
- Require signed SOW amendment before we provision the buffer (we can provision a soft buffer immediately but reserve the right to bill if SOW not signed within 48h)

Billing checklist for the SOW: total buffer size (120M tokens), buffer rate, credit condition (usage within buffer + 20% next-month forecast), effective window (72h), and DocuSign link. I’ll prepare the billing note for the invoice team.

— Marissa (Finance Ops)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Temporary uplift and buffer proposal (BrightCart) — please confirm

Elena — following internal review, here’s the formal short-term proposal so we can move immediately: 

Summary (72-hour window):
- Provision: temporary 3x throughput uplift for 72 hours starting on acceptance
- Buffer: 120,000,000 tokens placed in a burst escrow buffer
- Pricing: buffer consumption billed at $0.00018/token (60% of list overrun rate); consumption beyond buffer billed at standard overrun rate ($0.00030/token)
- Credit: one-time $12,500 good-faith credit applied to your next invoice if month-after usage stays within buffer + 20% margin
- Conditions: we’ll provision a soft buffer immediately to avoid throttling. SOW amendment must be signed within 48 hours for continued buffer and to trigger the credit.

Next steps: 1) Please reply ACCEPT to this thread if you want us to provision the soft buffer now; 2) If ACCEPT, we’ll send a 1-page SOW amendment via DocuSign (link below).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABCD-3456-proposal
SOW draft attached: SOW_uplift_draft.pdf

If you’d like different numbers (larger buffer or longer window) we can run the math and surface the delta for approval.

— Soojin
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_uplift_draft.pdf (2 pages)]
